summary: Polestar filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of debt-to-equity conversions by Geely Sweden Automotive and Volvo Cars, converting $300M and $66M of loans into Class A ADS, respectively, plus a €50M increase in a green trade finance facility. No shareholder vote, premium, or board recommendation is involved; it is an ordinary financing update. The filing does not trigger any special-situation event, as it merely executes previously announced agreements and updates credit facilities. No risk-arb angle or transaction conflict applies.
